title: Kestrel Return Balance Plan — Return Balance Payment on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Contracts
content:
Under the Kestrel return balance plan, a customer whose vehicle financed under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract has come back under the return option makes a return balance payment on that contract.

## When the payment is fixed

The return balance payment is fixed only after the excess mileage charge for the return stands billed on the contract. The return balance payment is not fixed until the excess wear charge for the return stands billed on the contract. Before the return balance payment is fixed, the return fee for the return must stand billed on the contract.

Put another way, the return balance payment has no fixed amount while any one of the excess mileage charge, the excess wear charge or the return fee for the return does not yet stand billed on the contract.

## Posting on a returned contract

For a return balance payment on a balloon contract in returned status, and only for such a payment, the payment may be posted while the contract status is returned and is applied in the payment allocation order, which on a returned contract carrying no principal and nothing past due places all of it on fees due. Every other payment, which is posted outside this rule and its tool, remains bound by the payment posting rule that a payment can be posted only while the contract status is active, assigned for repossession, repossessed or deficiency.

## When return charges fall due

For return charges placed on a return balance plan under this rule, and only for those charges, the charges fall due in the monthly installments this rule sets, the first being the return balance payment. Return charges not placed on a plan, whether settled in one return balance payment under this rule or not yet paid, stay due the tier's charges-due days in calendar days after billing; the account still closes when they are paid and unpaid charges are still charged off the tier's charge-off days after the return, as the vehicle return rule states.

## Customer payment: `pay_return_balance_installment_2f123e0a`

**What it does.** The customer pays, through Kestrel's automated phone payment line, a return balance payment on their own balloon contract, drawn by ACH from their own bank account. One call posts one payment dated today on the `phone_ivr_ach` channel with purpose `installment`, applies the whole amount to the contract's fees due (booking the matching fee payment entry) and lowers the fees due balance by that amount. No convenience fee is collected on this channel.

**How it is run.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `pay_return_balance_installment_2f123e0a` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `balloon_contract_id` | The reference number of the customer's balloon contract being paid, as read out by the agent from the balloon contract lookup | Id string |
| `amount` | The payment amount in USD | Decimal number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent, no currency symbol; drawn and posted exactly as given |
| `funding_account_last4` | The last four digits of the customer's own bank account the payment is drawn from | 4 digits, exactly as the customer states them; never empty for this payment |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence stating the payment reference, the amount posted in USD with 2 decimal places, the posting date in YYYY-MM-DD form, the channel `phone_ivr_ach`, the last four digits of the bank account drawn and the contract's remaining fees due in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the payment is posted.
